objective: Diagnosticar exclusivamente en READ_ONLY por que fallo el sql_readonly_audit del Gate3B de Custodia. No reemplaza ni clona el Gate3B funcional. No DDL/DML, no cambios de repositorio, no Produccion.

queries.name: identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, ORIGINAL_LOGIN() AS original_login, SUSER_SNAME() AS effective_login;

queries.name: metadata_tables_access
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (20) s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id WHERE s.name='dbo' ORDER BY t.name;

queries.name: canonical_targets_presence
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND t.name IN ('RH_Colaboradores_Expediente','RH_Cat_Puestos','Producto_Catalogo','ActivoFijo_Activos','Sistema_Empresas','Unidades_Negocio','Sistema_Sucursales','Usuario_Catalogo','Gobierno_Documento','RH_Nomina_Detalle') ORDER BY t.name;

queries.name: permission_probe
queries.sql: SELECT HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(DB_NAME(),'DATABASE','CREATE TABLE') AS can_create_table, HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo','SCHEMA','ALTER') AS can_alter_dbo, HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(DB_NAME(),'DATABASE','VIEW DEFINITION') AS can_view_definition;
